How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return with us:
If you’re in the UK: go to the online returns portal, search for “Chillys,” and follow the steps to choose your return method.
If you’re outside the UK: post your unused item to the Bedford warehouse address shown on your dispatch note, ideally with a tracked/signed service.
We don’t offer free returns, and products must be unused and in saleable condition. Engraved items can’t be returned unless they’re faulty. For damaged or faulty products, please don’t post them back—keep the item and contact our Customer Service team via the support widget instead. Bundle items need to be returned as a complete, unused bundle; we can’t take just part of a bundle.
Our sources don’t mention a separate exchange process, only refunds via returns, so you’d follow the same return steps and then place a new order if you’d like a different product.
